historical_context: The Scott Monument is a Victorian Gothic monument to Scottish author Sir Walter Scott. It was completed in 1844 and is located in the Princes Street Gardens in Edinburgh. It is the second-largest monument to a writer in the world.
verified_facts: The Scott Monument was designed by George Meikle Kemp.
It is constructed from Binny sandstone.
It is situated in East Princes Street Gardens, Edinburgh.
